title: Horizons Extra
description: Modpack for mchorizons.online server. Includes optimization and visual upgrade mods
body:
# Horizons Extra Modpack

**Horizons Extra Modpack** is a highly optimized Fabric client modpack built specifically for **mchorizons.online**, combining extreme performance tuning, modern visuals, and polished quality-of-life features — all while remaining fully vanilla-friendly and multiplayer-safe.

The modpack is designed for players who want Minecraft to feel **fast, smooth, responsive, and immersive** without altering gameplay mechanics.

---

## 🚀 Performance & Optimization

Horizons Client focuses on aggressive but safe optimizations to deliver consistently high FPS and low latency, even on large servers:

- Advanced rendering and memory optimizations (Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, ModernFix, ImmediatelyFast)
- Smart and aggressive culling of unseen blocks and entities (EntityCulling, MoreCulling, CullLeaves)
- Reduced RAM usage and garbage collection pressure
- Faster chunk loading and smoother world traversal
- Network and packet optimizations for stable multiplayer gameplay (Krypton, PacketFixer)
- Automatic FPS reduction when tabbed out to save resources (Dynamic FPS)

The result: **higher average FPS, fewer stutters, and smoother gameplay in all situations** — from exploration to combat and busy hubs.

---

## ✨ Visual Enhancements (Vanilla-Style)

Without changing core Minecraft mechanics or aesthetics, the modpack significantly improves how the game looks and feels:

- Full shader support via **Iris**, with performance-friendly presets
- Dynamic and scalable lighting (LambDynamicLights, ScalableLux)
- Improved grass, leaves, block connections, and textures (Continuity, BetterGrassify)
- Enhanced entity models and textures
- Subtle visual effects, particles, and polish that make the world feel more alive
- Clean and modern rendering with minimal visual noise

Everything stays true to the **vanilla Minecraft style**, just cleaner, smoother, and more immersive.

---

## 🎮 Quality of Life Features

Horizons Client includes carefully selected QoL improvements that enhance comfort without giving unfair advantages:

- Built-in **simple voice chat** for immersive multiplayer interaction
- Advanced and customizable HUD elements
- Smooth inventory interactions and UI animations
- Zoom functionality and improved GUI rendering
- Minimap and world map for navigation (client-side only)
- Improved sound design and spatial audio for better immersion

All features are configurable and designed to stay out of your way during gameplay.

---

## 🛡 Multiplayer & Server Safety

- **100% client-side**
- Fully allowed and compatible with **mchorizons.online**
- No cheats, automation, or gameplay-altering features
- Safe for competitive and fair multiplayer environments

You get better performance and visuals — **not unfair advantages**.

---

## 🎯 Who Is This Modpack For?

- Players who want **maximum FPS and stability**
- Multiplayer-focused players who value smoothness and responsiveness
- Players who enjoy **clean, modern visuals without modded gameplay**
- Anyone who wants Minecraft to feel optimized, polished, and modern

---

If you want Minecraft to **run faster, look better, and feel smoother** —  
**Horizons Client Modpack** is built exactly for that.
